sloka: कृतास्त्रम् अकृतास्त्रम् वा न एवम् शक्ष्यन्ति राक्षसाः ।गुप्तम् कुइशिक पुत्रेण ज्वलनेन अमृतम् यथा ॥१-२१-९॥
transliteration: kṛtāstram akṛtāstram vā na evam śakṣyanti rākṣasāḥ ।guptam kuiśika putreṇa jvalanena amṛtam yathā ॥1-21-9॥

translations.english: Trained or not in the use of arms, as long as Rama is protected by Viswamitra, just as nectar is protected by the flaming firegod rakshasas will not be able to compete with him.
